description: Gets an item data by `itemId`; refer to an item (memory, entry, stance, etc) by its GUID identifier `id`, no other retrieval will work
name: getSummary

itemId.description: Guid id of item data to retrieve

summaryOnly.description: When `true` retrieve _just_ the item summary, use `false` to get entire object with metadata; most cases, summary is sufficient unless you or member is trying to display or update metadata
